title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Work IQ APIs billed pay-as-you-go in Copilot Credits
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents administrator activation of billing before Work IQ API usage, rather than an unstated default. The service usage report does not report individual users, and its API supports application permissions despite the briefing saying all its Graph calls are delegated only.
